verdict.rationale: Greptile runs autonomously in the background on PR events. It automatically reviews every pull request with configurable review triggers, and per-PR behavior is set via greptile.json. It also auto-generates unit tests and diagrams per PR, and TREX runs PR branches in a sandbox, leaving logs and screenshots on the PR. These automations are limited to the built-in PR-review pipeline, though, rather than user-defined automations; Greplooping and Fix-with-Agent rely on a coding agent or a button click rather than running unattended. Missing for 10: general-purpose user-defined automations (scheduled or custom-triggered workflows beyond PR review), documented fully unattended fix loops, and independent hands-on corroboration of background automation.
